body:
Source: GitHub issue #905 (bug, P1-high, area:review). Re-verified on main @ 982adee7: packages/prosecute/lib/tier.mjs:147-154, the rails-deny-path loop inside classifyTrustRootTier, iterates `tickets` and calls globMatch(glob, path) for every ticket.rails entry WITHOUT ever reading ticket.completed. Completed tickets T37 and T38 (completed: true) declare packages/** as a rail, so classifyTrustRootTier currently reports isTrustRootTier:true (reasons citing T37/T38) for ANY change under packages/, forcing the signed cross-model record-cross-model ceremony on every ordinary package bugfix. packages/rails-guard/lib/ci/rail-freeze.mjs already honours the T36 completion lifecycle (`if (ticket.completed === true) continue;` at line 142, and again in sanctionedAdditions logic) — the two gates disagree about which rails are live.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `packages/prosecute`: bin/adlc-prosecute.mjs is the CLI entry (tier-check, record-cross-model, etc.); lib/tier.mjs holds the pure classifyTrustRootTier({changedFiles, tickets}) classifier (this file is what you edit); lib/cross-model.mjs, lib/attestation-store.mjs, lib/schema.mjs, lib/run.mjs are unrelated P5 machinery — do not touch them. Tests: `npm test -w packages/prosecute` from the worktree root (or `node --test packages/prosecute/test/*.test.mjs`). packages/prosecute/test/tier.test.mjs and packages/prosecute/test/tier-merge-base.test.mjs already cover classifyTrustRootTier's other surfaces and are NOT rails — extend tier.test.mjs directly with new describe blocks, or add a sibling test file; both are fine.

HOW loadTicketsForTier (bin/adlc-prosecute.mjs:358-370) feeds this: it UNIONS tickets read from the base branch tip AND from the worktree/HEAD ticket store — deliberately widening-only (a ticket added after the branch point still contributes rails). Because of this union, a HEAD-only edit that flips one ticket copy to completed:true cannot itself escape tiering while the same ticket's BASE copy (still not completed) is still in the unioned array contributing its rails — the fix does not need to read tickets from any particular revision; filtering per-ticket-object inside classifyTrustRootTier's existing loop is sufficient and safe by construction of the caller's union. Do not add a base-tip-only read to tier.mjs — that would duplicate rail-freeze's separate, differently-scoped mechanism for no benefit here.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In classifyTrustRootTier's `for (const ticket of ...)` loop (tier.mjs:147), skip a ticket entirely (do not evaluate its rails globs at all) when `ticket.completed === true` — a strict boolean check, exactly matching rail-freeze.mjs:142's reading (not truthy, not `'true'` the string, not any other value).
2. classifyTrustRootTier's signature, return shape ({isTrustRootTier, reasons}), and its other 3 tier surfaces (TRUST_ROOT_FILES exact-match, ENFORCEMENT_PREFIXES, PRODUCER_PREFIXES) are unaffected — this ticket touches ONLY the rails deny-path loop's ticket filtering.
3. Regression guard: a ticket with rails matching a changed path and NO `completed` field (undefined), or `completed: false`, must still tier exactly as today — only `completed === true` is new.
4. Documentation: update `packages/prosecute/README.md` and hand-edit the same statement into `docs/tools/prosecute.md` and `apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/prosecute.mdx` (mirrors — never regenerate) noting that a completed ticket's rails no longer count toward trust-root tiering, matching rail-freeze's T36 lifecycle.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 A ticket with `completed: true` and rails `["packages/**"]` does NOT tier a `packages/foo/lib/x.mjs` change (isTrustRootTier: false, reasons: []) when no other tier surface applies. verify: `node --test packages/prosecute/test/tier.test.mjs`
- AC2 The SAME ticket object with `completed` omitted (or `completed: false`) DOES tier the identical change (isTrustRootTier: true, reasons includes the rails deny-path reason). verify: `node --test packages/prosecute/test/tier.test.mjs`
- AC3 A completed ticket's rails are skipped even when a DIFFERENT, non-completed ticket in the same `tickets` array also declares rails matching the same path — the change still tiers via the non-completed ticket's reason (proves the fix filters per-ticket, not by short-circuiting the whole loop). verify: `node --test packages/prosecute/test/tier.test.mjs`
- AC4 Existing tier.test.mjs and tier-merge-base.test.mjs suites stay green unmodified (no existing pinned case exercises a completed ticket, so none should need rewriting — confirm this by reading them, not by assumption). verify: `npm test -w packages/prosecute`
- AC5 Docs updated in all three places. verify: `grep -c "completed" packages/prosecute/README.md docs/tools/prosecute.md apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/prosecute.mdx` (each >= 1)
- AC6 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (also run `--max 80` once locally before review)

OUT OF SCOPE: rail-freeze.mjs itself (already correct, cited only as the existing precedent to match); any change to loadTicketsForTier's base/HEAD ticket sourcing; issue #904/#903/#902 (the observed symptomatic PRs) — this ticket fixes only the classifier they exposed. This fix lives under packages/prosecute/, an ENFORCEMENT_PREFIXES surface, so it is itself trust-root tier and needs the cross-model record-cross-model ceremony once before merge — expected, not a defect.
title: prosecute: tier-check must skip rails of completed tickets
